description:
EXCELLENT OPPORTUNITY FOR FIRST-TIME BUYERS, DOWN-SIZERS & INVESTORS
 
Tony Donnelly and Leonard Wilson Keenan are delighted to present this charming two-bedroom detached cottage to the market. Set on a generous and highly desirable c. 0.35-acre site, this property beautifully combines traditional charm with modern convenience, featuring a bright kitchen extension to the rear. One of its standout features is the exceptionally private, mature garden and secure off-street parking, accessed via private electric gates.

Superb Location
Ideally situated on the Dublin Road, the property boasts an enviable location directly opposite the Athy Primary Care Centre, the local Rugby Club, and the GAA club. Residents will enjoy ultimate convenience, with Athy town centre, the train station (perfect for commuters), the local swimming pool, primary and secondary schools, and all essential local amenities within comfortable walking distance.
 
Accommodation
The deceptively spacious accommodation is well-laid out and comprises:
•	Entrance Hall: A welcoming entry point to the home.
•	Sitting Room: A cosy yet airy living space featuring a striking raised ceiling and a solid fuel stove.
•	Kitchen / Dining Area: Located in the rear extension, offering a bright and functional space for cooking.
•	Bedrooms: Two well-proportioned double bedrooms.
•	Shower Room: A fully equipped, practical family shower room.
•	Attic: A spacious attic providing ample storage.
 
Services & Features
•	Site Size: Generous 0.35-acre plot with private, mature gardens including two garden sheds
•	Security: Fully Alarmed with Secure parking and electric gate access.
•	Heating: Dual heating system (Oil-fired central heating & solid fuel stove).
•	Utilities: Mains water and mains sewage.
 
Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the space, privacy, and potential this wonderful cottage has to offer.
